flags.why: Tựu trung introduces a summary meaning 'in sum' or 'overall', rather than functioning as the verb 'to boil down to' ([reference](https://giaophanphucuong.org/bai-viet/tieng-viet-online/moi-tuan-mot-tu-ngu-bai-4-tuu-chung-hay-tuu-trung)).
This use belongs mainly to formal speech and writing and needs a register warning ([reference](https://vdict.com/t%E1%BB%B1u%20trung%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
The older sense means 'among them' or 'within that group', rather than the verb 'to include' ([reference](https://luom.tv/2024/01/20/tuu-trung-khong-phai-tuu-chung/)).
flags.fix: adv [literary] | among them; within that group
